related_issues.reason: Same symptom: a project with readme = "README.org" fails to build (uv sync, build backend error). Closed as a question, not a uv defect. Useful context, but it is a build failure report, not a request for README.org to be supported by default, so not a duplicate.

rationale: The reporter asks uv to accept README.org by default, without a stated defect. Docs (config.md) define no README format allow-list, and the request is for different behaviour, so enhancement, matching the reporter's label. No reproduction is needed because the request is clear and the body states the error is about extension recognition. Search found closed #9821 (README.org build failure, labelled question) as related context; it is not an exact duplicate. I did not confirm which component (uv or the build backend) emits the 'not recognized' error and the issue gives no error text, so likely_external is false with medium confidence; a maintainer should check which backend rejects the .org file before routing.
